_comment_not_in_battery: Several rules are verified outside this ART battery, all documented in phase-4-detection/sigma/README.md and proven by phase-4-detection/sigma/sigma-selftest.py: (1) T1105 certutil download (rules 100500/1) — Microsoft Defender kills certutil download before it spawns, so there's no telemetry (defense-in-depth, not a gap). (2) T1562.001 Defender exclusion via PowerShell (ps_script rule 100506) — this host's offline Atomic Red Team bundle has no T1562.001 atomic, so it was live-fired manually (Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath) to prove the ps_script->Wazuh path fires end-to-end, then the exclusion was removed. (3) T1560.001 (archive staging, rules 100517-519) — no offline-viable ART atomic exists (the rar/7-Zip/WinZip tests all require downloading the installer; the one self-contained test uses .NET ZipFile, not the Compress-Archive cmdlet the ps_script rule keys on) — validated instead via a direct Compress-Archive invocation in ad-validate.py. (4) T1047/T1021.006/T1569.002 (WMI/WinRM/PsExec lateral movement, rules 100513-516) and T1190 (DMZ web attack, rules 100440-442) aren't ws-01-local ART atomics at all — they're attacks launched FROM atk-01 (against ws-01 or dmz-01), so they live in ad-validate.py alongside the AD attack scenarios, which already models exactly that shape.
